text: City Council has authorized the City Clerk to shortlist, interview and recommend candidates to Community Councils for appointment to the Moss Park Arena Board. This report recommends two candidates for appointment to the board.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following candidate to the Moss Park Arena Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on April 2, 2030, and until a successor is appointed: - Karin Fritzlar 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 13, 2026) from the City Clerk remain confidential in its entirety as it relates to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Moss Park Arena.
